summary.text: John Suiter is a Republican state representative from Hillsborough 36 who took office in December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an Iraq War veteran and has served as a selectman in Mason.

paragraphs.text: John Suiter's career experience includes working as a selectman for the town of Mason, and Ballotpedia describes him as a veteran of the Iraq War.
Suiter assumed office in the New Hampshire House on December 4, 2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the general election ballot for Hillsborough 36.
